_comment: Example thresholds for the benchmark-level cases. Copy, edit to the SLOs of *your* deployment, and export VF_BENCH_THRESHOLDS_JSON=<path> (or the JSON inline). Numbers here are what one developer box (this repo's compose broker on a 32-core host) sustains; they are not a claim about any other environment.

MSG-026._restart_note: restart_broker_container names the compose broker container the recovery half restarts (docker restart); drop the key to skip that half.

PAY-022._note: declared_capacity_cameras is the admission claim under test: it must sit at or below the measured sustainable camera count minus headroom. On the reference box two cameras at 10 fps x 1 MB sustain the SLO, so a claim of 1 with 25% headroom holds. max_drop_ratio is 2%, not 0: a live_latest frame path drops a frame whenever a reader lags for one retention slot, and one frame in 120 is what a shared developer box does while something else runs — a real SLO names the loss the deployment tolerates, and 0 is a legitimate value on a quiet machine.
